name: TitanSigma
description:
TitanSigma unifies all your data and sends it to your BI tool, simplifying how you track KPIs and metrics.
No more digging through spreadsheets or chasing down reports.
Just clear numbers your team can use to run the business better.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TitanSigma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TitanSigma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://titansigma.app/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TitanSigma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TitanSigma lists 17 MCP tools, including attach_dataset, create_project, create_report, delete_project, delete_report, deploy_project, get_deploy_status, get_project, get_report, list_organizations, list_projects, and list_reports.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TitanSigma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TitanSigma in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
TitanSigma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TitanSigma is developed by Peaka. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
